content.text:
Investigation complete. Findings:

- **sec-1 (Purpose)**: engagement is expressly "task by task" via individual Statements of Work — no minimum-volume, requirements, or sole-provider commitment on Clear Capital.
- **sec-3 (Compensation)**: time-and-materials per SOW; no fee, penalty, or shortfall charge triggered by using other suppliers.
- The three "exclusive" hits are unrelated: p0020 (Contractor's IP ownership), p0021 (non-exclusive license *to* us — benefits us), p0051 (entire-agreement boilerplate).
- p0047 is a **mutual** non-solicitation of employees — a different category, not exclusive dealing.

No exclusivity or sole-supplier obligation binds our party, which is the preferred position. No redline needed.

input.quote: Company agrees to retain Contractor to perform the consulting services for Company, on a task by task basis (the "Services"), and Contractor agrees to furnish the Services on the terms and subject to the conditions set forth in this Agreement.
input.rationale: The Agreement imposes no exclusivity or "sole supplier" obligation on Clear Capital, which meets the preferred position. The engagement is structured on a "task by task basis" through individually negotiated Statements of Work (p0004), and compensation is time-and-materials per SOW (p0013) with no minimum-volume commitment, requirements obligation, or fee/penalty triggered by our use of other suppliers. Targeted searches for "sole/exclusive provider", "all of its requirements", "shall not procure/purchase/engage", and competing-vendor restrictions returned nothing. The only "exclusive" references are unrelated: Contractor's retained IP ownership (p0020), a non-exclusive license granted to us (p0021, which benefits our party), and entire-agreement boilerplate (p0051). The mutual non-solicitation of employees at p0047 is a different category and is not exclusive dealing, so it is not flagged here. Clear Capital remains free to buy comparable services from other suppliers; no redline required.
